bad_interval: The interval must be finite, non-negative and increasing
past_end: {source} has {limit:.2f} seconds of footage; end_s can be at most that
too_long: video_qa rejects intervals longer than 20 minutes
too_many_frames: The sampling gives {count} frames; at most 650 are allowed
out_of_context: The vision model ran out of context with {count} frames ({prompt_tokens} prompt tokens) and gave no answer; ask about a shorter interval or with a lower fps
too_many_images: The vision model's provider rejected the request because {count} frames are more images than it accepts, and gave no answer; ask about a shorter interval or with a lower fps
no_evidence: The vision model answered without evidence frames; ask again
bad_evidence: The vision model cited frames outside the sampled sequence; ask again
no_answer: The vision model returned no answer; ask again
